caption:
Asian Inspired Smashed Eggs
breakfast recipe | under 30 minutes 

Nutrition: 
C: 4 | F: 14 | P: 14
Calories: 200 per serving ( without bread ) 
Serves 1

Ingredients
2 eggs, softboiled - thats 6 minutes then dunk in ice water for 1 -2 minutes before peeling 
1 1/2 tsp greek yogurt / mayo
1 tsp chilli oil
1 spring onion greens, finely chopped
3-4 birds eye chilli, dont have then use green chillies ( adjust as per taste) 
salt + pepper to taste

Method
mash the boiled eggs and add in all the ingredients to it and combine 
garnish with white sesame seeds ( optional ) 
serve on some crusty sourdough or enjoy as is :)
